tactistat ask "Why was Morocco so hard to break down at the 2022 World Cup?"
steps.output:
Morocco’s defensive organization kept opponents from scoring in several key matches, holding Croatia and Spain to 0‑0 draws and beating Belgium 2‑0 in the group stage[2]. Their goalkeeper Yassine Bounou made crucial saves, including two penalties in the round‑of‑16 shoot‑out against Spain[2]. This combination of disciplined defending and decisive goalkeeping helped them become the first African and Arab team to reach a World Cup semi‑final[1][2].
